🚀 From Documents to Decisions: Reimagining Intelligent Document Processing with GenAI

📄 How can Generative AI take document processing beyond simple data extraction to drive smarter business decisions? 🧠

🎤 Join Aiham Taleb, Nikita Kozodoi, PhD, and me at AWS Deep Dive Days – Generative AI!

💡 We'll explore how multimodal AI is transforming Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), and what it takes to bring these solutions from prototype to production. ⚙️

📅 November 5, 2026
⏰ 13:30–14:15 CET
📍 AWS Munich (MUC14)

🔗 Event details: https://lnkd.in/eFB-VhyS

🙌 Looking forward to seeing you there!
#GenerativeAI #AWS #IntelligentDocumentProcessing #MultimodalAI

Happy to be in Budapest for EMNLP 2026! 🇭🇺

Tomorrow I'm presenting our joint work from the collaboration between AUMOVIO and the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Generative AI Innovation Center at the REALM workshop: the journey of building an engineering assistant for automotive software, and the tooling behind it. It has been a great collaboration, and I'm really looking forward to sharing it with the research community.

Thank you to my co-authors Aiham Taleb, Nikita Kozodoi, PhD, Daniel Schleicher, Amir Mahdi Namazi, Martin Kraus, Levent Kent and Brian Jensen.

If you're in Budapest and would like to chat about automotive, agentic systems, time series or anything else, let me know or come find me at our poster. Always happy to meet!  😊 

Paper: https://lnkd.in/d3_gRhCd 
Workshop: https://lnkd.in/dvRykybn

posts.text:
Excited to present 3 papers on LLM optimization, scaling and merging at COLM in San Francisco! 🇺🇸 

Always happy to chat with fellow scientists at the Amazon booth and exchange ideas on where the field is going, and how to keep up with the speed of research.

Kudos to my co-authors from the AWS FDE team: Jack Butler, Zainab A., Egor Krasheninnikov, Sergey I., Natalia Tarasova
Great energy at AWS Summit Dubai! It was inspiring to meet so many builders and showcase our team’s work to customers across the region.

Meet us at AWS Summit Dubai next week! 🇦🇪

Our team will demo custom solutions we built for real business use cases, including voice and video AI, deep research agents, and physical AI. If you want to learn more about AWS Forward Deployed Engineering, and chat about agentic AI and model customization - find us at the AI/ML zone!

📅 September 30, Dubai World Trade Centre
🔗 Register: https://lnkd.in/ehjXFrW3

🇨🇭 Great time at AWS Summit Zurich!

Philipp Kaindl and I gave a talk on red teaming. As more applications rely on LLMs and AI agents, it becomes critical to know how to protect them against adversarial attacks like prompt injection, agent goal hijacking, context poisoning and many others. Always happy to discuss this topic with the community!

🎓 I completed all four Anthropic certifications this month: Associate, Developer, Architect Foundations, and Architect Professional.

The material generalizes well beyond Claude. Context management, tool and prompt design, MCP, evaluation, and cost and latency tradeoffs are the same problems whether you build on Claude, Codex, Kiro, or anything else. I face most of these regularly in customer projects.

I would recommend these exams to two groups: anyone building AI agents, and engineers who use coding assistants daily and want to get more out of them. Preparing for the exams showed me a few gaps in my own setup.
Check out our new blog post on how we worked with AUMOVIO to build agents that detect software issues and vulnerabilities in automotive C/C++ code.
